title: Claude overview: what it does, who it suits and what it costs
summary: Claude is Anthropic's AI assistant, used to write, analyse, work through problems and handle longer documents, with separate plans for individuals, teams and enterprises.
pros: Free plan includes web search, file creation and memory
Team and Enterprise plans add central billing, SSO and admin controls
cons: Usage limits apply on every plan and reset on a rolling five-hour window; paid plans add weekly limits
The pricing page gives no fixed message count
bestFor: People in these groups, according to the vendor's own description: individuals, teams of 2 to 150 users (team plan), large organisations (enterprise).
skipIf: The first limitation in our record matters to you: Usage limits apply on every plan and reset on a rolling five-hour window; paid plans add weekly limits.
pricingNote: Pricing is verified as of 2026-10-29, in the vendor's own currency. Published plans: Free is free; Pro is $20 per month billed monthly or $17 per month billed yearly; Max is $100 per month; Team (Standard seat) is $25 per month billed monthly or $20 per month billed yearly; Team (Premium seat) is $125 per month billed monthly or $100 per month billed yearly.
verdict: From its official pages, Claude is aI assistant from Anthropic. This overview was written from documentation and our catalog record, not from testing, so check the limits above against your own use and confirm current prices on the official page before paying.

title: Perplexity overview: what it does, who it suits and what it costs
summary: Perplexity is an AI answer engine that searches the web and shows the sources behind an answer, so you can open and check them.
useCases: Quick research where you want sources
Getting oriented on an unfamiliar topic
Finding pages to read in full
pros: Shows sources for answers
Paid Pro tier adds extended Pro Search and file uploads
cons: Free usage is limited
A summary can still misread a source, so open the links for anything important
bestFor: People in these groups, according to the vendor's own description: researchers, students, professionals who need cited answers.

verdict: From its official pages, Perplexity is aI answer engine with cited sources. This overview was written from documentation and our catalog record, not from testing, so check the limits above against your own use and confirm current prices on the official page before paying.
